strings.En misiones largas, muchas astronautas h: On long missions, many women astronauts have taken the combined contraceptive pill continuously so as not to have periods. With menstrual suppression there is no phase to follow: this variation refers to women with a natural cycle.

strings.La cifra sale de la temperatura central: The figure comes from core temperature (0.3 to 0.7 °C, Baker's review) and oral temperature on waking (0.23 °C, Maijala). The skin figures (0.30 to 0.33 °C at finger and wrist) go in the same direction and do not count towards the figure: skin is not the temperature of the indicator. The difference is seen mostly while asleep or on waking.
strings.Solo temperatura de piel de muñeca (Good: Wrist skin temperature only (Goodale 2019: lower in the follicular phase than during menstruation); core temperature during menstruation versus the follicular phase was not found in what was read.
strings.La cifra frente a la folicular es una re: The figure versus the follicular phase is a subtraction of published nocturnal means from a single study (Goodale 2019, authors from the bracelet company): 59.98 and 60.47 bpm in the early and late luteal phase versus 56.56 in the follicular phase. Alzueta 2022 gives +2.38 and +2.49 bpm in its table 2, but versus menstruation. No systematic review that was read gives the figure.
strings.Un solo estudio (Goodale 2019): 57,92 lp: A single study (Goodale 2019): 57.92 bpm during menstruation versus 56.56 in the follicular phase, nocturnal rate.
strings.Sentido documentado por dos revisiones s: Direction documented by two systematic reviews; magnitude in milliseconds not documented. That of Alzueta (−5.47 and −5.96 ms versus menstruation) was not significant.
strings.La única cifra leída (−18 ms, resta de 1: The only figure read (−18 ms, subtraction of 136 and 154 ms from Yazar 2016) is the 24 h SDNN of a Holter in 30 women, which is not the SDNN of a short window: it is not used as the figure of the indicator. The living review says that SDNN followed the trend of variability in about two thirds of the studies.
strings.La diferencia de la RMSSD entre la menst: The difference in RMSSD between menstruation and the follicular phase: the meta-analysis of Schmalenberger 2019 gives, in its abstract, only from menstruation and the mid-to-late follicular phase to the premenstrual phase; Alzueta 2022 uses menstruation as the reference and does not give the follicular phase; the «HRV ratio» of Goodale 2019 is not RMSSD.
strings.La SDNN en la menstruación frente a la f: SDNN during menstruation versus the follicular phase: Yazar 2016 compares only follicular and luteal; the living review by de Jager 2026 gives SDNN between quarters of the cycle without isolating menstruation; the meta-analysis of Schmalenberger 2019 does not deal with SDNN.
